prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a ready-made friend or generate a unique companion from your photo.", "Select pet style"]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Pet", "Quick guide to controlling, hiding, and speaking to your companion on your screen.", "Right-click pet to open settings and hide option", "Click and drag to move your pet around desktop", "Got It!"]
3: ["Upload a Clear Photo for Best Pet Results", "Follow the quality tips to build a perfect desktop companion.", "Choose Photo", "Use well-lit single subject photos"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Assets...", "We are calibrating animations and desktop overlay features.", "Creating pet assets...", "Tip: Right click your pet anytime to dock it to your taskbar."]
5: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original account to keep your existing pets.", "Existing Pet Sync Enabled", "Sign In with Existing Account"]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is officially ready! Give them a name to issue their adoption certificate.", "Sign Certificate & Continue", "Enter Pet Name"]
7: ["Choose Your Pet Journey", "Pick standard adoption for instant setup, or custom creator for a unique friend.", "Instant Pet vs Custom Creator", "Includes Free Starter Accessory Set!"]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Look at your desktop corner to find your new pet ready to play.", "Start Desktop Tour", "Bring Pet to Front"]
9: ["Generating Your Pet in Background", "Feel free to minimize this app. We will send a desktop notification when your pet is ready!", "Desktop Alert Enabled"]
